facets.note: What travels on a cable or bus.
A physical jack or connector, and the connector types.
A sound-generating or sound-shaping building block.
A settable value that belongs to a block, effect or sequencer.
A processor applied to an audio signal.
The step sequencer and what it arranges in time.
Something saved and recalled: presets, kits, projects.
A physical control a player uses to generate data or change a value.

concepts.note: Note on and note off are one concept here: the pair that starts and ends a note.
Polyhierarchy: a MIDI message by format, a sync signal by purpose.
An analogue pulse clock (the RD-9's SYNC OUT, Eurorack clocks).
A short pulse. Also the generic word for 'start' in some manuals, so the count is an upper bound.
A voltage-controlled oscillator: a KIND of oscillator (narrower), not a synonym. Same for VCF and VCA.
Polyhierarchy: an oscillator by construction, a modulation source by use.
'Emphasis' is the Roland-lineage name for the same control.
Also 'firmware release' and 'release the key' in some manuals, so the count is an upper bound.
The unit tempo is expressed in; close to tempo, not the same.
How long a step's note is held. Not the gate SIGNAL: see the 'gate' homograph.
Elektron's word for an event placed on a step. Other manuals say 'step' for both the slot and its note.
A step flag that switches glide on into the next note: close to glide, but it lives in the sequencer.
Four manufacturers' words for repeating a hit inside one step; each is kept as its own concept because they differ in detail, and linked as close matches.

homographs.label: HP
senses: high-pass filter (the Elektron manuals' filter pages)
horizontal pitch, the Eurorack panel width unit (this site's module specs)

homographs.label: gate
senses: the gate SIGNAL (a CV that is high while a note is held)
gate length/time: how long a sequencer step's note lasts

homographs.label: patch
senses: a patch cable, or the act of wiring one

homographs.label: sound
senses: Elektron: a stored set of one track's synth parameters (a preset)

homographs.label: pad
senses: a playing surface you strike (drum and trigger pads)
an input attenuation switch on the audio interfaces (PAD)

homographs.label: program
senses: a stored preset, as in 'program change'
